cell_kind: SAME-FLIGHT NODE COLUMN over the Solver instruction template -- 4 candidate templates + the twin aa paired per row against the delivering lock arm; claim ceiling nominated
claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.

contacts.scorer: CPU official scorer jobs over derived copies only

next_step: a NOMINATED or EFFICIENT-NO-LOSS arm goes to a 2-arm Fold A confirm (stated, not built)

primary.contrast: arm minus lock, paired per row
primary.metric: official SLURP SLU-F1 per arm column (one complete scoring per column, slurp-slu-official-train)

stages.1_columns: bash scripts/flights/nx/nxt_r3_read.sh columns  (stage3_rollout_score --mode supply-variants: one complete official scoring per arm; no number printed)
stages.smoke: python -B scripts/analysis/slurp_nxt_r3_solver_template_column_read.py --stage smoke (per-arm Solver decode cost; no countersignature; the machine sign-off input for the column flight)

what_is_not_here: No margins block and no admission: nothing is locked here.

word_rules.EFFICIENT-NO-LOSS: neither the SLU nor the intent delta shows a resolved loss (the NX-T R1 NO-RESOLVED-LOSS rule: SLU delta CI95 upper bound >= -|o|; intent delta CI95 upper bound >= -0.65 pp, the decision-190 intent floor) AND the Solver seconds per contact of the arm <= 0.85 x the lock arm's
word_rules.NOMINATED: SLU delta CI95 lower bound > 0 AND intent delta point >= -0.65 pp AND the SLU delta point is not below the twin bar (the SLU delta point is >= |o|, the absolute SLU delta point of the twin aa against lock)
